Google Pay (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.google.android.apps.nbu.paisa.user)
Digital wallet and payment system
List of all the information collected and associated to your Google account : https://support.google.com/googlepay/answer/10223752?hl=en&co=GENIE.Platform%3DAndroid#zippy=%2Cinfo-that-google-may-collect
You really should not trust Google not to sell your data (even if they claim the contrary): https://venturebeat.com/2020/11/20/probeat-google-will-eventually-sell-ads-against-your-financial-data/

The app itself has a LOT of permissions. See the Pithus analysis: https://beta.pithus.org/report/36b22c539b5f25c27a7699516c906351a25ba2daa2894eed08ae22f7a2a72c0e
